entries.title: Remove Cortana
entries.description: Removes the deprecated Cortana app for all users and deprovisions it.
entries.rationale: Cortana was deprecated in June 2023 and is no longer provisioned on Windows 11 24H2+; it only lingers on upgraded 22H2/23H2 images and has no remaining system role.

actions.reinstallHint: Cortana is deprecated and no longer distributed; there is no supported reinstall path (it exists only on older upgraded images).

sideEffects: No functional loss - Cortana's search integration was already removed from Windows.
Not re-provisioned after removal (absent on clean 24H2+ images).

entries.title: Remove Microsoft News (MSN)
entries.description: Removes the Microsoft News / MSN Start news app for all users and deprovisions it.
entries.rationale: The MSN news app is an ad-supported content app with no system dependency; the Widgets feed uses a different component and is unaffected.

actions.reinstallHint: Reinstall from the Microsoft Store, or `winget install --source msstore "Microsoft News"`.

sideEffects: The Widgets news feed uses the Web Experience pack, not this app, and keeps working.
May be re-provisioned by a feature update, and the Store may re-offer it.

entries.title: Remove MSN Weather
entries.description: Removes the MSN Weather app for all users and deprovisions it.
entries.rationale: MSN Weather is a standalone content app with no system dependency; the Widgets weather tile is independent.

actions.reinstallHint: Reinstall from the Microsoft Store, or `winget install --source msstore "MSN Weather"`.

sideEffects: The Widgets weather tile is independent and keeps working.
May be re-provisioned by a feature update.

entries.title: Remove Bing web-search app
entries.description: Removes the Bing web-results app that backs web answers in Windows Search (24H2+).
entries.rationale: This app only adds Bing web results to Start/Windows Search; removing it does not remove Windows Search itself. Remove only if you do not want web results in Start.

actions.reinstallHint: Reinstall from the Microsoft Store; a feature update also restores it.

sideEffects: Removes Bing web results from Start / Windows Search; Windows Search itself is unaffected.
Many users want web results in Start search - remove only if you do not.
In the EEA this is the officially uninstallable "Web Search from Microsoft Bing".
May be re-provisioned by a feature update or re-offered by the Store.

entries.title: Remove Microsoft Copilot app
entries.description: Removes the consumer Microsoft Copilot Store app for all users and deprovisions it.
entries.rationale: The consumer Copilot app is an optional assistant; after removal the Copilot hardware key falls back to Search (or whatever SetCopilotHardwareKey specifies).

actions.reinstallHint: Microsoft Store: ms-windows-store://pdp/?productid=9NHT9RB2F4HD

sideEffects: The Copilot hardware key falls back to Search (or whatever SetCopilotHardwareKey specifies).
Re-offered by Windows Update/Store and re-pinned after feature updates; the consumer Copilot app is not permanently removable without a policy or AppLocker rule.

entries.title: Remove Microsoft 365 Copilot (Office Hub)
entries.description: Removes the Microsoft 365 Copilot app (formerly the Microsoft 365 / Office hub) for all users and deprovisions it.
entries.rationale: This is a launcher/hub for Microsoft 365; removing it does not affect installed Office desktop apps.

actions.reinstallHint: Microsoft Store: ms-windows-store://pdp/?productid=9WZDNCRD29V9

sideEffects: On Entra/work accounts this is the Copilot-key default target; removing it makes the key fall back.
Re-offered by Windows Update/Store and auto-installed for Microsoft 365 desktop users.

entries.title: Remove new Outlook for Windows
entries.description: Removes the new Outlook for Windows app for all users and deprovisions it.
entries.rationale: The new Outlook is an optional mail client. Note that legacy Mail and Calendar reached end of life on 31 Dec 2024, so removing new Outlook can leave no built-in mail client.

actions.reinstallHint: Reinstall from the Microsoft Store, or `winget install --source msstore "Outlook for Windows"`.

sideEffects: Legacy Mail and Calendar reached end of life on 31 Dec 2024, so removing new Outlook can leave no built-in mail client.
On 24H2+ the deprovisioning sticks; on 23H2 (pre-March 2024) and Windows 10 it can be re-offered via the UScheduler_Oobe updater.

entries.title: Remove legacy Mail and Calendar
entries.description: Removes the legacy Mail, Calendar and People (windowscommunicationsapps) bundle for all users and deprovisions it.
entries.rationale: The legacy Mail/Calendar apps reached end of life and only remain on upgraded machines; the new Outlook replaces them.

actions.reinstallHint: Legacy Mail and Calendar are end of life and no longer distributed; use the new Outlook for Windows instead.

sideEffects: Legacy Mail, Calendar and People are end of life and only present on upgraded machines.
Removed from the Windows image in late 2024 and not re-provisioned.

entries.title: Remove People app
entries.description: Removes the standalone People app for all users and deprovisions it.
entries.rationale: The People app was only a dependency of the legacy Mail/Calendar apps and has no remaining role.

actions.reinstallHint: Reinstall from the Microsoft Store if still listed; the People app is legacy.

sideEffects: Was only a dependency of the legacy Mail/Calendar apps.
Not re-provisioned after removal.

entries.title: Remove Microsoft Teams (new)
entries.description: Removes the new Microsoft Teams app (free/work) for all users and deprovisions it.
entries.rationale: The bundled Teams app is optional; removing it clears the taskbar Chat/Teams entry and nothing else depends on it.

actions.reinstallHint: Reinstall from the Microsoft Store, or `winget install --source msstore "Microsoft Teams"`.

sideEffects: Removes the taskbar Chat/Teams entry; nothing else depends on it.
Re-provisioned by feature updates on consumer SKUs and re-offered by Windows Update.

entries.title: Remove Teams personal (legacy Chat)
entries.description: Removes the legacy personal Teams / Chat app (22H2/23H2) for all users and deprovisions it.
entries.rationale: The old personal Teams/Chat app is superseded by the new Teams and has no dependencies.

actions.reinstallHint: Reinstall the current Teams from the Microsoft Store; the legacy personal Teams is no longer distributed.

sideEffects: Legacy personal Teams/Chat (22H2/23H2); nothing depends on it.
Not re-provisioned after removal.

entries.title: Remove Sticky Notes
entries.description: Removes the Microsoft Sticky Notes app for all users and deprovisions it.
entries.rationale: Sticky Notes is an optional notes app; notes synced to your Microsoft account remain available online.

actions.reinstallHint: Reinstall from the Microsoft Store, or `winget install --source msstore "Microsoft Sticky Notes"`.

sideEffects: Local, unsynced notes are lost; notes synced to your Microsoft account remain.
May be re-provisioned by a feature update.

entries.title: Remove Microsoft To Do
entries.description: Removes the Microsoft To Do app for all users and deprovisions it.
entries.rationale: To Do is an optional task app with no system dependency; task data stays in your Microsoft account.

actions.reinstallHint: Reinstall from the Microsoft Store, or `winget install --source msstore "Microsoft To Do"`.

sideEffects: No dependencies; To Do data stays in your Microsoft account.
May be re-provisioned by a feature update.

entries.title: Remove Get Help
entries.description: Removes the Get Help app for all users and deprovisions it.
entries.rationale: Get Help is used by Windows troubleshooters and support links; remove it only if you do not use them.

actions.reinstallHint: Reinstall from the Microsoft Store, or `winget install --source msstore "Get Help"`.

sideEffects: Settings > System > Troubleshoot troubleshooters launch Get Help; Windows Update and Activation "Get help" links stop working.
May be re-provisioned by a feature update.

entries.title: Remove Tips
entries.description: Removes the deprecated Tips (Get Started) app for all users and deprovisions it.
entries.rationale: Tips was deprecated in November 2023 and cannot be uninstalled from Settings, but PowerShell/Appx removal works; only some "learn more" links use it.

actions.reinstallHint: Reinstall from the Microsoft Store if still listed; the Tips app is deprecated.

sideEffects: Some "learn more" / tips links stop working.
Deprecated Nov 2023; may be re-provisioned by a feature update until removed from the image.

entries.title: Remove Power Automate
entries.description: Removes the Power Automate desktop app for all users and deprovisions it.
entries.rationale: Power Automate is an optional automation app preinstalled on many images; it has no system dependency.

actions.reinstallHint: Reinstall from the Microsoft Store, or `winget install --source msstore "Power Automate"`.

sideEffects: No dependencies.
May be re-provisioned by a feature update.

entries.title: Remove Windows Maps
entries.description: Removes the Windows Maps app for all users and deprovisions it.
entries.rationale: Maps was deprecated in April 2025 and removed from the Store in July 2025; only rare offline-maps consumers depend on it.

actions.reinstallHint: Windows Maps was removed from the Microsoft Store in July 2025; there is no supported reinstall path.

sideEffects: Rarely, other apps' offline-maps features rely on it.
Deprecated Apr 2025 and removed from the Store Jul 2025; not re-provisioned.

entries.title: Remove Windows Clock
entries.description: Removes the Windows Clock app (alarms, timers, focus sessions) for all users and deprovisions it.
entries.rationale: The Clock app is optional; the only integration is the Focus sessions entry in Settings/notification centre.

actions.reinstallHint: Reinstall from the Microsoft Store, or `winget install --source msstore "Windows Clock"`.

sideEffects: The Focus sessions entry in Settings / notification centre uses this app.
May be re-provisioned by a feature update.

entries.title: Remove Windows Camera
entries.description: Removes the Windows Camera app for all users and deprovisions it.
entries.rationale: Windows Hello enrolment does not need the Camera app, but several webcam features and OOBE checks do; remove only if you do not use them.

actions.reinstallHint: Reinstall from the Microsoft Store, or `winget install --source msstore "Windows Camera"`.

sideEffects: Windows Hello enrolment does not need it, but Snipping Tool webcam/recording, Teams "test camera" links and the OOBE camera check use it; some Copilot+ Studio Effects entry points too.
In the EEA this is the officially uninstallable Camera app.
May be re-provisioned by a feature update.

entries.title: Remove Windows Calculator
entries.description: Removes the Windows Calculator app for all users and deprovisions it.
entries.rationale: Calculator has no functional dependencies, but most users expect it to be present - hence a cautious, opt-in removal.

actions.reinstallHint: Reinstall from the Microsoft Store, or `winget install --source msstore "Windows Calculator"`.

sideEffects: No functional dependencies, but most users expect Calculator to be present.
May be re-provisioned by a feature update.

entries.title: Remove Notepad (Store)
entries.description: Removes the Store version of Notepad for all users and deprovisions it.
entries.rationale: Notepad is the default .txt handler and the notepad.exe alias points to it; remove only if you use another editor. To keep Notepad but drop its AI features, use the DisableAIFeatures policy instead.

actions.reinstallHint: Reinstall from the Microsoft Store, or `winget install --source msstore "Windows Notepad"`.

sideEffects: Default .txt handler; the notepad.exe alias points to it (the classic Notepad is a separate Feature-on-Demand, Microsoft.Windows.Notepad.System).
To keep Notepad but disable its AI features, set HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\WindowsNotepad\DisableAIFeatures=1 instead of removing it.
May be re-provisioned by a feature update.

entries.title: Remove Paint
entries.description: Removes the Paint app for all users and deprovisions it.
entries.rationale: Paint is the default image editor and the mspaint.exe alias points to it; remove only if you use another editor. To keep Paint but drop its AI features, use the Paint policy keys instead.

actions.reinstallHint: Reinstall from the Microsoft Store, or `winget install --source msstore "Paint"`.

sideEffects: Default image editor; the mspaint.exe alias points to it.

To keep Paint but disable its AI (Cocreator/Generative Fill/Image Creator/Generative Erase/Remove Background), set those Disable* values under HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Paint instead.
May be re-provisioned by a feature update.

entries.title: Remove Snipping Tool
entries.description: Removes the Snipping Tool app for all users and deprovisions it.
entries.rationale: Snipping Tool backs the screenshot and screen-recording shortcuts; remove only if you use another tool.

actions.reinstallHint: Reinstall from the Microsoft Store, or `winget install --source msstore "Snipping Tool"`.

sideEffects: Breaks PrtScn-to-Snipping-Tool, Win+Shift+S screenshots and built-in screen recording.
May be re-provisioned by a feature update.

entries.title: Remove Sound Recorder
entries.description: Removes the Windows Sound Recorder app for all users and deprovisions it.
entries.rationale: Sound Recorder is an optional recording app with no system dependency.

actions.reinstallHint: Reinstall from the Microsoft Store, or `winget install --source msstore "Windows Sound Recorder"`.

sideEffects: No dependencies.
May be re-provisioned by a feature update.

entries.title: Remove Microsoft Photos
entries.description: Removes the Microsoft Photos app for all users and deprovisions it.
entries.rationale: Photos is the default image viewer for JPG/PNG/HEIC and more; Microsoft explicitly recommends against removing it. Install an alternative viewer first.

actions.reinstallHint: Reinstall from the Microsoft Store, or `winget install --source msstore "Microsoft Photos"`.

sideEffects: Default image viewer for JPG/PNG/HEIC and more; Microsoft explicitly recommends against removing it - install an alternative viewer first (legacy Windows Photo Viewer is not registered on Windows 11).
May be re-provisioned by a feature update.

entries.title: Remove Windows Media Player
entries.description: Removes the Windows Media Player (Zune Music) app for all users and deprovisions it.
entries.rationale: Media Player is the default music and video handler, especially after Films & TV is removed; remove only if you use another player.

actions.reinstallHint: Reinstall from the Microsoft Store, or `winget install --source msstore "Windows Media Player"`.

sideEffects: Default music and video handler (especially after Films & TV is removed).
May be re-provisioned by a feature update.

entries.title: Remove Films & TV
entries.description: Removes the Films & TV (Movies & TV / Zune Video) app for all users and deprovisions it.
entries.rationale: Films & TV has been dropped from new images and superseded by Media Player; video playback falls back to Media Player.

actions.reinstallHint: Reinstall from the Microsoft Store (Media Player supersedes Films & TV).

sideEffects: Video playback default falls back to Media Player.
Dropped from new images (2024/25) and not re-provisioned; Media Player supersedes it.

entries.title: Remove Xbox Title Callable UI
entries.description: Removes the Xbox Title Callable UI (TCUI) app for all users and deprovisions it.
entries.rationale: TCUI provides Xbox Live sign-in flows and Store game-purchase dialogs and is reported to be needed by the Store, Photos and some games; remove only as part of a full Xbox opt-out.

actions.reinstallHint: Reinstall from the Microsoft Store; a feature update also restores it.

sideEffects: Reported to be needed by the Microsoft Store, Photos and some games; provides Xbox Live sign-in flows and Store game-purchase dialogs.
Best removed together with the other Xbox components, and only if you do not use any Xbox/Game Pass features.
May be re-provisioned by a feature update.

entries.title: Remove Xbox Game Bar
entries.description: Removes the Xbox Game Bar (Xbox Gaming Overlay) app for all users and deprovisions it.
entries.rationale: Game Bar backs Win+G, Game DVR capture and the controller bar; prefer disabling Game DVR over removal because removing it without neutralising the ms-gamebar: protocol produces popups.

actions.reinstallHint: Reinstall from the Microsoft Store, or `winget install --source msstore "Xbox Game Bar"`.

sideEffects: Removes Win+G Game Bar, Game DVR capture and the controller bar; some games call the overlay.
Removing it without neutralising the ms-gamebar: protocol produces "ms-gamebar" popups - prefer disabling Game DVR over removal.
May be re-provisioned by a feature update or the Store.

entries.title: Remove Xbox Game Bar plugin (legacy)
entries.description: Removes the legacy Xbox Game Bar plugin (Xbox Game Overlay) for all users and deprovisions it.
entries.rationale: The legacy Game Bar plugin is superseded by the Game Bar app and shares the same overlay/DVR dependencies.

actions.reinstallHint: Reinstall from the Microsoft Store; a feature update also restores it.

sideEffects: Legacy Game Bar plugin; same overlay/DVR dependencies as the Game Bar app.
May be re-provisioned by a feature update.

entries.title: Remove Xbox Identity Provider
entries.description: Removes the Xbox Identity Provider app for all users and deprovisions it.
entries.rationale: The Xbox Identity Provider handles Xbox Live sign-in; removing it breaks a wide range of games and Store game purchases, so it is an opt-out only for non-gamers.

actions.reinstallHint: Reinstall from the Microsoft Store; a feature update also restores it.

sideEffects: Breaks Game Pass, the Xbox app, Minecraft, Forza, any Xbox Live-enabled game and Store game purchases.
May be re-provisioned by a feature update.

entries.title: Remove Xbox app
entries.description: Removes the Xbox app (Game Pass client) for all users and deprovisions it.
entries.rationale: The Xbox app is the Game Pass PC client; removing it stops Game Pass installs but is otherwise optional.

actions.reinstallHint: Reinstall from the Microsoft Store, or `winget install --source msstore "Xbox"`.

sideEffects: Game Pass PC game installs go through the Xbox app and Gaming Services.
May be re-provisioned by a feature update or reinstalled from the Store.

entries.title: Remove Gaming Services
entries.description: Removes the Gaming Services package for all users and deprovisions it.
entries.rationale: Gaming Services underpins Game Pass installs and the Xbox app; the Store reinstalls it on demand when an Xbox feature next needs it.

actions.reinstallHint: The Store reinstalls Gaming Services on demand the next time an Xbox feature needs it.

sideEffects: Required for Game Pass installs and the Xbox app.
The Store reinstalls it on demand the next time an Xbox feature needs it.

entries.title: Remove Phone Link
entries.description: Removes the Phone Link (Your Phone) app for all users and deprovisions it.
entries.rationale: Phone Link provides cross-device features (phone photos, mobile-device panel); it is safe to remove but opt-in because it loses those integrations.

actions.reinstallHint: Reinstall from the Microsoft Store, or `winget install --source msstore "Phone Link"`.

sideEffects: Removes cross-device features: phone photos in Snipping Tool/File Explorer and the Start "mobile device" panel (the Cross Device Experience Host also participates).
May be re-provisioned by a feature update.

entries.title: Remove Mixed Reality Portal
entries.description: Removes the Mixed Reality Portal app for all users and deprovisions it.
entries.rationale: Windows Mixed Reality has been removed from Windows, so the portal is dead weight on current builds.

actions.reinstallHint: Windows Mixed Reality was removed in 24H2; there is no supported reinstall path.

sideEffects: Only used by Windows Mixed Reality headsets, a feature that has itself been removed.
Removed in 24H2 and not re-provisioned.

entries.title: Remove Quick Assist
entries.description: Removes the Quick Assist remote-help app for all users and deprovisions it.
entries.rationale: Quick Assist is used for remote help with family and helpdesk; many admins remove it for tech-support-scam prevention. Reinstall is via the Store (the old Feature-on-Demand no longer exists on Windows 11).

actions.reinstallHint: Reinstall from the Microsoft Store, or `winget install --source msstore "Quick Assist"`.

sideEffects: Removes Quick Assist remote help (used with family and helpdesk); the older App.Support.QuickAssist Feature-on-Demand no longer exists on Windows 11, so reinstall is via the Store.
Some admins remove it deliberately for tech-support-scam prevention.
May be re-provisioned by a feature update.

entries.title: Remove Remote Desktop (Store)
entries.description: Removes the Store Remote Desktop client for all users and deprovisions it.
entries.rationale: The Store Remote Desktop client only matters if you use AVD/Windows 365/RDS; it is being replaced by the new Windows App.

actions.reinstallHint: Reinstall from the Microsoft Store, or `winget install --source msstore "Remote Desktop"`.

sideEffects: Only matters if you use Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365 or RDS; it is being replaced by the new "Windows App".
Reinstallable from the Store.

entries.title: Remove Microsoft Family Safety
entries.description: Removes the Microsoft Family Safety app for all users and deprovisions it.
entries.rationale: Family Safety manages child-account controls; keep it on devices with child accounts, otherwise it is optional.

actions.reinstallHint: Reinstall from the Microsoft Store, or `winget install --source msstore "Microsoft Family Safety"`.

sideEffects: Removes Microsoft Family Safety features - keep on devices with child accounts.
May be re-provisioned by a feature update.

entries.title: Remove Microsoft Journal
entries.description: Removes the Microsoft Journal (pen) app for all users and deprovisions it.
entries.rationale: Journal is an optional pen/note app with no system dependency.

actions.reinstallHint: Reinstall from the Microsoft Store, or `winget install --source msstore "Microsoft Journal"`.

sideEffects: No dependencies.
Reinstallable from the Store (ships via OEM/Store).

entries.title: Remove Microsoft Whiteboard
entries.description: Removes the Microsoft Whiteboard app for all users and deprovisions it.
entries.rationale: Whiteboard is an optional collaboration app with no system dependency.

actions.reinstallHint: Reinstall from the Microsoft Store, or `winget install --source msstore "Microsoft Whiteboard"`.

sideEffects: No dependencies.
Reinstallable from the Store (ships via OEM/Store).

entries.title: Remove Dev Home
entries.description: Removes the Dev Home app for all users and deprovisions it.
entries.rationale: Dev Home's retirement was announced and it was removed from the Store in 2025; its Dev Drive/WSL settings pages moved into Settings.

actions.reinstallHint: Dev Home was removed from the Microsoft Store in 2025; there is no supported reinstall path.

sideEffects: Dev Drive and WSL settings pages have moved into Settings, so little is lost.
Retirement announced and removed from the Store in 2025; not re-provisioned.
